Hello, I'm Dev Prajapati.

I specialize in transforming raw and complex data into clear, actionable insights using Microsoft Excel. My expertise includes advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, interactive dashboards, data cleaning, reporting automation, and business analytics solutions.

With a strong background in Information Technology and Data Analysis, I help individuals, startups, and businesses streamline their workflows, improve decision-making, and save valuable time through efficient Excel-based systems.

Whether it's creating professional dashboards or building custom Excel solutions, my goal is to deliver accurate, user-friendly, and results-driven work that adds real value to every project.

What I Do

  • ✔ Excel Dashboard Development
  • ✔ Data Cleaning & Formatting
  • ✔ Pivot Table Analysis
  • ✔ Google Sheets Solutions

I am passionate about turning data into meaningful insights and helping clients achieve smarter, faster, and more informed business decisions.
